mainline/chifagui#2.zh: 却说山东济州郓城县有个东溪村，村中保正姓晁名盖，祖上是本乡富户，平生仗义疏财，专爱结识天下好汉。他曾独自把西溪村镇妖的青石宝塔夺了过来，因此人都称他「托塔天王」。
mainline/chifagui#2.t: Now, in Yuncheng County of Jizhou in Shandong, there was a village called East Creek. Its headman was Chao Gai, from a wealthy local family, generous and righteous, who loved to befriend the heroes of the land. He once carried off by himself the blue stone pagoda that guarded West Creek Village against ghosts, so everyone called him the 'Pagoda King'.

mainline/chifagui#3.zh: 看官听说：这一日，千里之外有条好汉，揣着一套泼天的富贵来投晁保正。只是他还没见着晁保正的面，倒先吃了一场官司。
mainline/chifagui#3.t: Listen, readers: on this day a hero from a thousand li away came to Chao Gai carrying news of a fabulous fortune. But before he'd even met Chao Gai, he ran into trouble with the law.

mainline/chifagui#4.zh: 原来本县步兵都头「插翅虎」雷横，奉知县之命领士兵下乡巡捕。这夜巡到灵官殿，见供桌上赤条条睡着一条紫黑阔脸、鬓边一搭朱砂记的大汉，当作贼人一条索子绑了，押到晁保正庄上歇脚。
mainline/chifagui#4.t: The county's infantry constable, 'Winged Tiger' Lei Heng, was out patrolling the villages with his men on the magistrate's orders. That night at the Lingguan Temple he found a big man with a broad dark-purple face and a red birthmark by his temple sleeping naked on the altar table. Taking him for a thief, Lei Heng tied him up and brought him to Chao Gai's manor to rest.

mainline/chifagui#5.zh: 晁盖认出这汉子是来投奔他的好汉，便认作自家外甥王小三，取十两花银送与雷横，放了他。
mainline/chifagui#5.t: Chao Gai recognised the man as a hero who had come to join him, so he claimed him as his own nephew, Wang Xiaosan, gave Lei Heng ten taels of silver, and had him released.

mainline/chifagui#6.zh: 俺姓刘名唐，江湖上都叫俺「赤发鬼」。平白吃那都头吊了一夜，又诈了晁保正十两银子……俺且赶上去，讨还了来，也教他认得俺！
mainline/chifagui#6.t: My name is Liu Tang, and the rivers and lakes call me the 'Red-haired Demon'. That constable strung me up all night for nothing and squeezed ten taels out of headman Chao... I'll catch up with him, get it back, and teach him who I am!

mainline/chifagui#7.zh: 刘唐拿了一条朴刀，出庄门大踏步赶来，赶了五六里路，望见雷横引着士兵慢慢地行。
mainline/chifagui#7.t: Liu Tang took a broadsword and strode out of the manor gate. After five or six li, he saw Lei Heng leading his men along at an easy pace.

mainline/chifagui#8.zh: 兀那都头，不要走！你晓事的，留下那十两银子还了我，我便饶了你！
mainline/chifagui#8.t: Hey, constable, don't go! If you know what's good for you, give back those ten taels and I'll let you off!

mainline/chifagui#9.zh: 是你阿舅送我的，干你甚事？我若不看你阿舅面上，直结果了你这厮性命！
mainline/chifagui#9.t: Your uncle gave it to me. What's it to you? If not for your uncle's sake, I'd finish you right now!

mainline/chifagui#10.zh: 我须不是贼，你却把我吊了一夜，又骗我阿舅银子！
mainline/chifagui#10.t: I'm no thief, yet you strung me up all night and swindled my uncle out of his silver!

mainline/chifagui#11.zh: 辱门败户的谎贼！你这贼头贼脸，必然要连累晁盖。弟兄们，与我拿下！
mainline/chifagui#11.t: Lying thief, a disgrace to your family! With that thieving face of yours, you're bound to drag Chao Gai into trouble. Men, seize him!

mainline/chifagui#12.zh: 雷横看晁保正面上，不肯下死手，只要拿他。
mainline/chifagui#12.t: For headman Chao's sake, Lei Heng won't strike to kill. He only wants to take him.

mainline/chifagui#13.zh: 刘唐被吊了一夜，手脚还有些麻木。
mainline/chifagui#13.t: Strung up all night, Liu Tang's hands and feet are still a little numb.

mainline/chifagui#14.zh: 胜利条件   --- 撑到第 7 回合晁盖赶来，或打倒雷横
mainline/chifagui#14.t: Victory --- Hold out until turn 7 when Chao Gai arrives, or defeat Lei Heng

mainline/chifagui#15.zh: 失败条件   --- 刘唐死亡

mainline/chifagui#16.zh: 两个就大路上斗了五十余合，不分胜败。后面的士兵见雷横赢不得，都拿了器械赶上来围裹。
mainline/chifagui#16.t: The two fought on the road for over fifty bouts with no winner. The soldiers behind, seeing Lei Heng couldn't win, came up with their weapons to surround him.

mainline/chifagui#17.zh: 只见侧首篱门开处，一个秀才模样的人掣两条铜链，叫道：
mainline/chifagui#17.t: Then a side gate in the fence opened, and a man dressed like a scholar came out holding two copper chains, calling:

mainline/chifagui#18.zh: 你两个好汉且不要斗！我看了多时，权且歇一歇，我有话说。
mainline/chifagui#18.t: You two heroes, stop fighting! I've been watching a long while. Take a rest; I have something to say.

mainline/chifagui#19.zh: 便把铜链就中一隔，两个都收住了手。
mainline/chifagui#19.t: He swung the chains between them, and both stopped.

mainline/chifagui#20.zh: 小生姓吴名用，人称「智多星」，在这村中教书。都头，看晁保正面上，且饶他这一遭。
mainline/chifagui#20.t: My name is Wu Yong, called the 'Wizard'; I teach in this village. Constable, for headman Chao's sake, let him off this once.

mainline/chifagui#21.zh: 畜生，不得无礼！……都头休怪，是小人这外甥不晓事，改日小人自来县里陪话。
mainline/chifagui#21.t: Beast, mind your manners! ...Constable, don't take offence. My nephew doesn't know any better. I'll come to the county another day to apologise.

mainline/chifagui#22.zh: 小人也知那厮胡为，不与他一般见识。保正，休怪，休怪！
mainline/chifagui#22.t: I know the fellow is a fool; I won't stoop to his level. Headman, no offence, no offence!

mainline/chifagui#23.zh: 雷横引了士兵自回县去。晁盖请刘唐、吴用到后堂坐定，刘唐这才说出来意：「小弟打听得一套富贵，特来送与哥哥！」三人商议到半夜，吴用道：「这件事人多做不得，人少也做不得。小生想起石碣村有三个弟兄，义胆包身，武艺出众，须得他们相助。」当下便说定，吴用明日去石碣村走一遭。
mainline/chifagui#23.t: Lei Heng led his men back to the county. Chao Gai invited Liu Tang and Wu Yong into the back hall, and only then did Liu Tang explain why he'd come: "I've learned of a fortune and came especially to give it to you, brother!" The three talked until midnight. Wu Yong said, "This can't be done with too many people, or with too few. I know three brothers in Stone Tablet Village, brave and loyal and fine fighters. We'll need their help." It was settled then and there: Wu Yong would go to Stone Tablet Village the next day.

mainline/chifagui#24.zh: 雷横招架不住，被刘唐一朴刀杆搠翻在地。刘唐正要上前，侧首篱门开处，一个秀才模样的人掣两条铜链抢将出来。
mainline/chifagui#24.t: Lei Heng couldn't hold him off and was knocked down by the shaft of Liu Tang's broadsword. Just as Liu Tang stepped forward, a side gate opened and a man dressed like a scholar rushed out holding two copper chains.

mainline/chifagui#25.zh: 好汉住手！打伤了官差，须连累晁保正！
mainline/chifagui#25.t: Stop, good fellow! Hurt an officer and you'll drag headman Chao into it!

mainline/chifagui#26.zh: 畜生，不得无礼！……都头休怪，是小人这外甥不晓事。
mainline/chifagui#26.t: Beast, mind your manners! ...Constable, don't take offence. My nephew doesn't know any better.

mainline/chifagui#27.zh: 罢，罢！看保正面上，不与他一般见识。
mainline/chifagui#27.t: Enough, enough! For the headman's sake, I won't stoop to his level.

mainline/chifagui#28.zh: 雷横扶着士兵自回县去。晁盖请刘唐、吴用到后堂坐定，刘唐这才说出来意：「小弟打听得一套富贵，特来送与哥哥！」三人商议到半夜，吴用道：「这件事人多做不得，人少也做不得。小生想起石碣村有三个弟兄，义胆包身，武艺出众，须得他们相助。」当下便说定，吴用明日去石碣村走一遭。
mainline/chifagui#28.t: Leaning on his soldiers, Lei Heng went back to the county. Chao Gai invited Liu Tang and Wu Yong into the back hall, and only then did Liu Tang explain why he'd come: "I've learned of a fortune and came especially to give it to you, brother!" The three talked until midnight. Wu Yong said, "This can't be done with too many people, or with too few. I know three brothers in Stone Tablet Village, brave and loyal and fine fighters. We'll need their help." It was settled then and there: Wu Yong would go to Stone Tablet Village the next day.

mainline/chifagui#29.zh: 刘唐寡不敌众，又被雷横拿了，押回郓城县去。晁盖的大事，也就此成了泡影……
mainline/chifagui#29.t: Outnumbered, Liu Tang was caught by Lei Heng again and taken back to Yuncheng. Chao Gai's great venture came to nothing...
